scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @hanamaru/contracts build && pnpm --filter @hanamaru/platform build && pnpm --filter @hanamaru/database build
scripts.typecheck:scripts: pnpm --filter @hanamaru/platform build && tsc --allowJs --checkJs --noEmit --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck --types node scripts/live-google-e2e.mjs scripts/live-product-auth-e2e.mjs scripts/live-delete-race-e2e.mjs scripts/mint-live-e2e-identity.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm test:release-guard && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.infra:validate: terraform -chdir=infra/terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=infra/terraform validate && node scripts/validate-runtime-contract.mjs
scripts.test:local: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:db && pnpm build && pnpm infra:validate && pnpm test:security && pnpm docs:validate && pnpm test:e2e
